title: Rollbar API Data Structure
description: Hierarchical structure documentation for Rollbar's key data entities including Items, Occurrences, Projects, and Deploys.

Item.description: A unique error or message group in Rollbar, aggregating multiple Occurrences with the same fingerprint

fields.fingerprint: string - Hash identifying this unique error group
fields.title: string - Human-readable error title
fields.first_occurrence_id: integer - ID of the first occurrence
fields.first_occurrence_timestamp: datetime - When this error was first seen
fields.last_occurrence_id: integer - ID of the most recent occurrence
fields.last_occurrence_timestamp: datetime - When this error was last seen
fields.unique_occurrences: integer - Number of occurrences in the current time window
fields.level: enum - debug | info | warning | error | critical
fields.environment: string - Environment where this item occurs
fields.assigned_user_id: integer - Assigned team member user ID
fields.resolved_in_version: string - Deploy version when this was resolved

Occurrence.description: A single instance of an error event sent to Rollbar

fields.timestamp: datetime - When the occurrence was received

children.data: OccurrenceData - Full occurrence payload with body, request, and context

OccurrenceData.description: Full payload of an occurrence including error details and context

fields.level: enum - debug | info | warning | error | critical
fields.timestamp: integer - Unix timestamp when the error occurred

OccurrenceBody.description: The error or message body of an occurrence

fields.trace.frames: array - Stack frames (each with filename, lineno, method, code)
fields.message.body: string - For log-type occurrences, the message text
fields.crash_report.raw: string - Raw crash report for mobile/native

Deploy.description: A deployment event reported to Rollbar for release correlation

fields.revision: string - Code revision (commit hash or tag)
fields.local_username: string - System username on deploy server
fields.comment: string - Deployment comment or release notes

Project.description: A Rollbar project organizing items, tokens, and team access
